nom: Curology Clear Pimple Patches for Face

avis.titre: This Product Does Exactky What It Claims!!
avis.texte: I purchased this as a stocking stuffer for my 20 year old daughter. She is a junior in college and was home for the holidays. I noticed her breakouts had increased and she said she’s starting to get whiteheads/pimples on her chin area and t zone. I saw this package and had heard very good things about this brand from my son who ordered a trial supply for his acne. (19 yo). He had great success with it, so I thought I would get the patches for my daughter to try when she has the occasional breakout. To add, my daughter loves the idea of the patches. She has tried several brands and most seem to help somewhat, but none do what this brand did. She applied a pimple patch to a larger, whitehead pimple. This is much better than squeezing it and risking getting a scar for life! She did this after a shower one night before bed. When she woke up the next morning she was shocked that the pimple patch completely removed all of the whitehead/pus from the pimple, reduced redness completely and her face looked 1000 times better. She was so excited to tell me all about it! It truly was amazing and def a product we will continue to purchase. 10/10 recommend! This brand was created by dermatologist. Their products actually work and the patches did exactly what they promised to do! I highly recommend the patches to anyone that struggles with whiteheads or acne. avis.titre: Most absorbent patch I have tried
avis.texte: These seem like they absorb more gunk than some other brands I have tried. They seem slightly thinner and more prone to sticking to themselves, which makes them a little more difficult to apply, but they work well. They adhere well, are inconspicuous on my skin and not hard to remove. I have bought brands that include multiple sizes of patch in each box, but have not found the smaller sized ones to be as useful, personally. These were a good unit price. I don’t love that the sheets are enclosed in plastic/foil pouches and that the sheets are plastic. Not sure about the biodegradability of the patches themselves, either, so I try to use them sparingly. Nothing else out there drains the yucky goop out of a swollen pimple as effectively and quickly, though. In order to work they do need to be making direct contact with the goop. These can’t drain a closed papule, but if you can bring it to a head with some benzoyl peroxide cream or a gentle warm compress first that can help. Once the patches have been saturated with exudate it is advisable to change them promptly so they aren’t exerting pressure that could contribute to scarring.

avis.titre: Works Fast & Reduces Pimples OvernightWorks Fast & Reduces Pimples Overnight
avis.texte: I continue to experiment with Spot Patch brands and these work well similar to Hero Spot Patches that are very popular. They stick well, stay on overnight, and noticeably reduce the size of blemishes by morning. I also like that they help prevent picking and speed up healing. Simple, effective, and great to keep on hand for breakouts. VALUE: Curology = cheaper per patch + more quantity (better value) compared to HERO brand

I recommend these Curology Emergency Spot Pimple Patches to everyone! They actually work. Whenever I have a pimple that's come to a head, I put one on before bed, and by the next morning it has extracted a lot of the buildup and looks much smaller. One thing to keep in mind is that these don't have micro-needles, so they're not the best option for deep, stubborn pimples that haven't developed yet. They work best on pimples that are already a little developed. Overall, these patches have been lifesavers for me. They're easy to use, stay on well overnight, and make a noticeable difference by morning. I'll definitely keep buying them.
My go to patches! They never fail and I love these better than other brands.
Easy to use and effective. Sometimes they curl up and become unusable if you dont properly put into sleeve again all the way.
Absolutely love these. Works manic everytime and definitely worth the subscription

Okay! I already use Curology products. I had terrible hormonal acne in my late 20’s and their products cleared me up for the most part! Due to their prices being higher than I’d like I never got these patches before. I usually use the Walmart brand for $3 and call it a day. Well I decided to purchase a random bundle of patches on Amazon for $10 that came with like 300 patches. They broke me out very bad. I have sensitive skin and I knew it was a gamble. Then I purchased Neutrogena patches and they stuck to my skin so bad I thought they would peel my skin off when I took them off. They didn't work though. So I ordered these curology patches and within 3 day it’s already better! They stick perfectly without hurting when I remove them. They also aren’t super shiny so I can wear them and not feel like it’s extremely noticeable. They help with redness as well. I will absolutely keep these in stock.

I've tried multiple pimple patches. But I'm no gen Z, so I don't rock those star/ hello kitty pimple patches. I exclusively looking for something discreet. I used co**x brand for the longest time, but after trying this curology one, I think i'll stick to it. Look at how discreet this sticker is. It looks like I put a photoshop blur filter on my skin! It doesn't make the pimple disappear like in one night, but I haven't had one that does that. Also, I always have pimple that's probably considered nodules, so they're deep in the skin, it hurts, you can't really pop it all, so I need is to make sure I don't touch it for days before it goes away (hopefully on its own). This sticker helps me with that, and maybe that contributes to making my pimple go away quicker too.
I've used these patches for some time now and they are pretty effective and go on the skin pretty seamless.

Product It’s self is great big fan of the patches, but the box was damaged like someone stomped on it. At least patches were wrapped in baggies if not, it would’ve compromised the product. The product itself is not what it used to be although the application blends onto the skin. The pimple patch itself isn’t as effective almost like it was stored in humid conditions.

avis.titre: A lifesaver for hiding and calming blemishes!
avis.texte: These patches have been an absolute lifesaver for me when dealing with stubborn blemishes! They are easy to apply and help calm down the redness after a spot comes to a head, effectively hiding imperfections. Compared to other patches I have used, these are thicker but still remain relatively invisible. A helpful tip I discovered is to apply them with dry hands to dry skin to ensure they adhere well. I have worn these patches overnight and found them effective for calming redness and irritation. I highly recommend adding these to your skincare toolkit!

avis.titre: Sturdy, Flexible, Helpful Patches! Clean Presentation!
avis.texte: I really like pimple-patches such as Starface for the occasional blemish. They are so much tidier and effective than a liquid treatment (that gets on pillows and linens as you sleep). These arrive nicely boxed and there are four sealed, individual packets here. That means that you can open one and leave the rest sealed and protected. That is the ideal! Each patch is easy to remove from the sheet (which is not the case with all patches) and is super flexible. The patch applies easily and remains put. No matter how much you toss and turn in your sleep, the patch is going nowhere until you remove it. And, you can see the healing after night one! Inflammation and redness is quickly reduced! These make short work of those occasional blemishes. Such a clean and effective treatment. Nice!

avis.titre: Where were these when I was young?
avis.texte: Review: Curology Emergency Spot Patch, Hydrocolloid Pimple Patches for Face, 80 Count 🏎️ Quick Rec: Buy if you swear by the Curology brand & like to use acne patches. I wish they had these things when I was younger because they help, a lot. 🔢 My Scoring: Cleanliness 🫧🫧🫧🫧🫧 Durability 💪💪💪💪💪 Design & Aesthetic ❤️❤️❤️❤️ Value for Price 🪙🪙🪙 Repairability 🪚 Utility 🦺🦺🦺🦺🦺 🙂 Overall: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ✅ Pros ✅ - They show signs of visible improvement within a couple hours. Work a lot better if you can leave them overnight. - Durable, they don’t fall off easily. - Good size, they treat the spot in question & immediate area around it. The entire patch is treated so you don’t have some adhesive edges that are not doing anything. ❌ Cons ❌ - At $18 for 80, it is much more expensive than other options on the market. You’re paying for the brand name - though it may be worthwhile if you have sensitive skin with other brands/sellers out there.

Box was beat up like this and opened when I received and opened the package. Product itself is great and was all there so I kept it because they were a gift but unfortunately that’s how I received them.

These work well to pull out pimple drainage. I like the that I can place them on my skin and do my routine with serums and a moisturizer over it and they don’t move. They are pretty thin, so they taper to the skin and don’t stick up off of it as much as others. Also, I find that these really adhere to peach fuzz more than any other that I’ve used before which makes them a little uncomfortable to take off.

These do not seem to absorb gunk as well as the others, my pimples have been refilling which usually never happens. I also have to use several of these on one pimple. Im going back to PanOxyl.
Not a sealed box. Had 1 of 2 sealed envelopes of patches so it either fell out or fell into someone’s pocket. Disappointing.

Absolutely love these patches. They have done wonders to help for my breakouts. However, when they come delivered like this, it's a little unsettling. The product itself is absolutely amazing, but this service from Amazon if very VERY disappointing.
It arrived in this condition, crushed and open. I've tried them, and they don't work well at all. They leave a residue on my skin and don't remove blemishes as other similar ones. Not worth buying.
That is how it came. Ripped and looks used. The rest of the items in the package are fine but this looks used or previously returned

Opened the “brand new” box and inside were patches but only one small pack of 20 patches so. I have no idea why it’s advertised as 80… what a rip off. I usually order it straight from curology and these patches are great.

The package arrived basically ripped open, also patches were missing. Ive bought this in store before so the product is actually great and pretty much invisible on the skin. So 10/10 on product, but 0/10 on delivery.
I received my package today and opened my box and much to my dismay, it had already been opened and used. This is unacceptable. Will definitely rethink about ordering this again. Not happy at all.

I’ve been using blemish patches for years now and there are some differences between the qualities of them that makes some stand out from the crowd. In essence it’s three qualities I look for: adherence, performance and cost. These patches from curology check all those boxes! They stay put when on, do a great job drawing out impurities and are priced affordably. I really like how thin they are too! This makes them less noticeable when I’m wearing them. I’d get these again!
These patches are amazing ! They help with breakouts and are easy to apply !
